articles.title: Meet *sshole, the vulnerability that lets hackers SSH into Linux devices
articles.content: Certain configurations of Alpine are affected. Other distros may be as well.

articles.title: Hackers exploited iOS and Android flaws to infect phones
articles.content: Researchers say group may have been Kremlin-sponsored in search of diplomatic targets.

articles.title: OpenAI is stepping back from NDAs for data center projects
articles.content: Following this week's midterms where voters resoundingly voiced their opposition to data center expansion, OpenAI today announced new commitments to communities where it is working on data center projects, including that it won't use non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) with public officials. Many data center projects have come under scrutiny for relying on NDAs to hide discussions […]
